title: The schedule of deeds: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara
summary: The book Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. read in his dars, 'the timetable of those who count themselves poor in the way of Allah', and the order of its lessons.

blocks.p: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara is a book by Bahr-ul-Uloom, Hazrat Muhammad Abdul Qadeer Siddiqui Hasrat R.A. Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. read it in his dars over many sessions and explained it line by line.

blocks.q: This book of Bahr-ul-Uloom, Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, is the timetable of those who count themselves poor in the way of Allah.

blocks.p: Who are the fuqara? 'All these people sitting here,' Hazrat says. 'If you listen to their book, you are called a faqir.' He asks everyone to read it again and again, because it teaches not only the murid but the shaykh too.

blocks.h: The lessons, in the order he read them

steps: Part 1: why a murshid is needed, bai'at, and the aim of the book.
Part 2: tawbah (repentance); the human being as soul and body; Shariat, Tariqat, Haqiqat, Marifat; faith between fear and hope.
Part 3: taqwa; 'the Sufi is the son of time'; tawakkul; istikhara; nearness through the obligatory and the voluntary (Qurb-e-Faraiz and Qurb-e-Nawafil).
Part 4: sabr, tasleem and raza; the vices of the tongue and the heart; the nafs and Shaytan; fana-e-af'aal.
Parts 6 and 7: daf'-e-khatrat, driving away stray thoughts.
Part 8: chilla, i'tikaf, Saum-e-Maryam, Hizbul Bahr, prayer with a gathered heart, and where du'as are accepted.
Part 9: tasawwur-e-shaykh and the adhkar that help it.

blocks.note: There is no transcript of part 5 in the project yet, so it is not covered here.

blocks.h: A few lines from the book

blocks.q: Taqwa is to eat less, sleep less, speak less, to weep over one's own wrongs, and to overlook the faults of others.
To rely on Allah for your needs: this is called Tawakkul. Not working is not tawakkul.
Whatever work you have to do, do it by asking Allah. This is Istikhara.
Sabr is to bear hardships and difficulties, even while the heart finds them hard.

blocks.p: When a person bears difficulties with no resentment or complaint in his heart, it is called tasleem. When he begins to find sweetness in every pain and keeps praising Allah, he has reached raza: pleased however Allah keeps him.
Hazrat also says the book is only a beginning: 'It is not enough to just listen to it here. You have to read it again and again.'

blocks.note: The last line is from the machine transcript of part 8 (2:35), which is rough; check the wording against the recording.

ru.title: Aamaal ka nizaam: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara
ru.summary: Woh kitaab jo Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. apne dars mein padhte the, 'un logon ka time-table jo Allah ke raaste mein apne aap ko faqeer samajhte hain', aur uske asbaaq ki tarteeb.

blocks.p: Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, Bahr-ul-Uloom Hazrat Muhammad Abdul Qadeer Siddiqui Hasrat R.A. ki kitaab hai. Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. ne isko apne dars mein kai nashiston mein padha aur line-ba-line samjhaaya.

blocks.q: Bahr-ul-Uloom ki yeh kitaab, Nizam-ul-Amal-e-Fuqara, un logon ka time-table hai jo Allah ke raaste mein apne aap ko faqeer samajhte hain.

blocks.p: Fuqara kaun hain? 'Yeh sab log jo yahaan baithe hain,' Hazrat farmate hain. 'Agar aap unki kitaab sunte hain to aap faqeer kehlaate hain.' Woh sab se kehte hain ke isko baar baar padho, kyunke yeh sirf murid ko nahin, shaykh ko bhi sikhaati hai.

blocks.h: Asbaaq, us tarteeb se jis mein Hazrat ne padhe

steps: Part 1: murshid ki zaroorat kyun hai, bai'at, aur kitaab ka maqsad.
Part 2: tauba; insaan rooh aur jism ka majmooa; Shariat, Tariqat, Haqiqat, Marifat; imaan khauf aur umeed ke darmiyaan.
Part 3: taqwa; 'Sufi waqt ka beta hai'; tawakkul; istikhara; faraaiz aur nawaafil ke zariye qurb (Qurb-e-Faraiz aur Qurb-e-Nawafil).
Part 4: sabr, tasleem aur raza; zabaan aur dil ki buraaiyaan; nafs aur Shaitaan; fana-e-af'aal.
Part 6 aur 7: daf'-e-khatrat, bhatakte khayalaat ko door karna.
Part 8: chilla, i'tikaf, Saum-e-Maryam, Hizbul Bahr, dil jama' karke namaz, aur woh jagah jahaan duaayein qabool hoti hain.
Part 9: tasawwur-e-shaykh aur woh azkaar jo us mein madad karte hain.

blocks.note: Part 5 ka koi transcript abhi project mein nahin hai, isliye woh yahaan shaamil nahin.

blocks.q: Taqwa yeh hai ke kam khaana, kam sona, kam bolna, apni ghaltiyon par rona, aur doosron ke aib se nazar hata lena.
Apni zarooraton ke liye Allah par bharosa karna: isko Tawakkul kehte hain. Kaam na karna tawakkul nahin hai.
Jo bhi kaam karna ho, Allah se poochh kar karo. Yahi Istikhara hai.
Sabr yeh hai ke takleefon aur mushkilon ko bardaasht karna, chaahe dil ko woh mushkil lagein.

blocks.p: Jab aadmi mushkilon ko dil mein koi naaraazgi ya shikwa rakhe baghair bardaasht kare to isko tasleem kehte hain. Jab usko har dard mein mithaas mehsoos hone lage aur woh Allah ki hamd karta rahe, to woh raza tak pahunch gaya: Allah jaise bhi rakhe, us mein raazi.
Hazrat yeh bhi farmate hain ke kitaab sirf ek shuruaat hai: 'Sirf yahaan sun lena kaafi nahin. Isko baar baar padhna hai.'

blocks.note: Aakhri baat part 8 (2:35) ke machine transcript se hai, jo kachcha hai; alfaaz recording se mila lijiye.
